column1: The Space Shuttle Columbia disaster occurred in February 2003 when the orbiter disintegrated during re-entry, killing all seven crew members.
NASA's Apollo 11 mission landed the first humans on the Moon on July 20, 1969, with astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.
A graphics processing unit (GPU) is specialized electronic circuitry designed to rapidly manipulate memory to accelerate image and video rendering.
The Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991, emphasizing code readability.
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.
The 20 Newsgroups dataset is a collection of approximately 20,000 newsgroup documents, commonly used for text classification experiments.
